ad-hoc: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
app-store: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
apple-named-root: does not chain to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
developer-signed: chains to the test root; no profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
development-ber: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
development: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
enterprise: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
expired: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
forged-apple-link: does not chain to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: certificate signature failure
incomplete-apple-chain: does not chain to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: unable to get local issuer certificate
no-keychain: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
not-signed: does not chain to the test root; no profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: signature does not verify
other-bundle: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
self-signed: does not chain to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate
tampered: does not chain to the test root; no profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
wildcard: chains to the test root; profile-signing extension; to Apple's root: self-signed certificate in certificate chain
